records.name: Taller Puertorriqueño
records.summary: A Puerto Rican arts and culture center in North Philadelphia. It has a gallery, a bookstore, public events, free art programs for young people, and a yearly fundraising dinner. It takes volunteers for events and internships.
records.what_you_do: See the exhibitions, go to a public event, book a guided tour or workshop, enroll a child in the after-school program, or send the volunteer and internship form.

schedule.text: Gallery is open Monday 9 am to 5 pm and Tuesday to Saturday 10 am to 6 pm, closed Sunday. The after-school program runs Monday to Friday, 3 to 6 pm.

cost.text: Gallery admission is free. Public events vary: the October 10, 2026 fundraising dinner is $125 for an individual seat. The after-school program has a one-time $30 registration fee.

first_step.how: Visit the gallery during open hours, or fill out the volunteer and internship interest form on the Get Involved page. Questions: 215.426.3311 or info@tallerpr.org.
first_step.basis: Gallery visits and public events are open to anyone, and the site lists clear ways to join as a member, volunteer, or student.

records.notes: Membership levels: Local $35 a year, Individual $50 a year, Dual $120 a year, Family $240 a year, Supporter $480 a year. Youth programs are described here and not recorded separately, because they share this site. After-School Cultural Enrichment is for K to 8 students, Monday to Friday 3 to 6 pm, starts October 5, 2026, is free with a one-time $30 registration fee, and uses an English application. Young Artist Program covers ages 13 to 26: Estudio is free for currently enrolled high school students (Thursdays 3:30 to 6:30 pm), and Photography Without Borders is free for ages 14 to 26 (Wednesdays 4 to 6:30 pm, Saturdays 11 am to 2 pm). One Google Form covers both. A part-time maintenance job is also posted, but it is a job, not a volunteer role. Summer Camp exists; its details were not read.

records.name: Asian Arts Initiative
records.summary: An arts center on Vine Street with a free gallery, exhibitions, performances, community nights, and free youth arts programs for middle and high school students. It takes volunteers and program ideas through forms on its site.
records.what_you_do: Visit the gallery on Thursday, Friday, or Saturday, buy a ticket to a performance or community night, book a gallery tour, volunteer through the form, or ask about the youth programs.

schedule.text: Gallery is open Thursday to Saturday, 2 to 6 pm. Performances and events run on their own dates, such as Careoke Club Vol. 1 on October 9, 2026 from 6 to 9 pm and the Artist Town Hall on October 19, 2026 from 6 to 8:30 pm.

cost.text: Gallery admission is always free. Performance prices vary: the October 9, 2026 Careoke night is $15 to $25, and the October 19, 2026 Artist Town Hall is free with a pay what you wish option.

first_step.how: Come to the gallery Thursday to Saturday, or buy a ticket for an event. To volunteer or book a gallery tour, use the Google forms linked under Get Involved. Phone: (215) 557-0455.
first_step.basis: Gallery visits and public events are open to anyone. The youth programs do not explain how to enroll on the site.

records.notes: Youth programs are described here and not recorded separately, because they share this site and none publishes a weekly schedule. Youth Arts Workshop serves middle school students; summer 2026 registration was open and a 2026 to 2027 school year interest form is linked. Youth Leadership Initiative is free for grades 9 to 12 and asks people to send an inquiry, with no meeting times shown. Camp Bruce Lee is for ages 10 to 14 and was on hiatus this summer. The contact email is hidden behind an obfuscated link, so it is left out. The site lists an Eventbrite page for each ticketed event.

records.name: The Village of Arts and Humanities
records.summary: A community arts and youth organization on Germantown Avenue in North Philadelphia. It runs youth arts and farm education, a media lab, and neighborhood projects with young people and local residents.
records.what_you_do: Call or email to ask about youth arts classes or the Philly Earth farm classes, take part in a neighborhood project, or join the newsletter. The site lists no volunteer openings.

schedule.text: Office hours are Monday to Friday, 10 am to 5 pm. The site does not list meeting days or times for its youth programs.

locations.label: The Village of Arts and Humanities

cost.text: The site calls the Village Youth arts education free. Other program costs are not shown.

first_step.how: Call 215-225-7830 or email info@villagearts.org and ask about youth programs. The site does not describe an enrollment process.
first_step.basis: The site does not explain how to enroll in its youth programs, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: Program pages are described here and not recorded separately, because they share this site and none shows a weekly schedule. Village Youth is an arts program with no age range or meeting times, and its page is dated 2024-10-01. Philly Earth is a farm and environmental education program for ages 9 to 19, with after-school and summer classes and no times shown; its page is dated July 28, 2023. Civic Power Studio is a media lab with no times shown. CRED Philly Magazine is on hiatus, and its page is dated July 28, 2023. Creative Campus, SPACES AIR and People's Paper Co-op appear as program pages on this site and were not checked. The only open role on the Join Our Team page is an Emerging Leader Fellow with applications reviewed from April 11, 2025. Partners The Futures Gallery and Fairhill-Hartranft ABCs were not recorded because their domains did not resolve.

records.name: Mt. Airy Learning Tree
records.summary: An adult learning center in Mt. Airy. It runs paid classes in arts, cooking, computers, fitness, gardening, and more, and holds a yearly garden tour and a house tour as fundraisers. Anyone can sign up for a class, and teachers can propose one through a form.
records.what_you_do: Take a class in person or online, propose a course to teach, or help with the garden tour and other events. The site does not list volunteer sign-ups or a membership.

schedule.text: Office hours are Monday to Thursday, 9 am to 2 pm. Classes run in terms, and each listing shows its own dates, such as Fall 2026 courses that meet on October 8 and October 15, 2026.

cost.text: Classes are paid and fees differ by course. One online marketing course lists a $49 fee. A scholarship fund and gift certificates are listed on the site.

first_step.how: Sign up for a course through the online catalog, or send a course proposal through the form on the Want to Teach page. Phone: 215-843-6333.
first_step.basis: Classes are open to all adults with online sign-up, and several listed courses are labeled for beginners.

records.notes: The site describes no membership and no volunteer sign-up. The volunteer side is limited to the 2026 Annual Hidden Gardens Tour, held June 14, 2026, whose recap thanks garden docents and Flower Power Garden Committee members but gives no way to sign up. The West Mt. Airy Historic House Tour is ticketed, and no date was seen. Teaching is paid work: instructors receive 30 percent of the course fee for in-person classes and 40 percent for online classes. Teachers must provide clearances to teach anyone under 18. The proposal page conflicts with itself: it says Spring 2027 proposals are taken from mid-April to June 2027, but also gives a January 15, 2027 Spring deadline. Ask the office which is right. Garden tour raised about $18,000 according to the recap.

records.name: Smith Memorial Playground & Playhouse
records.summary: A free play space in East Fairmount Park with a giant wooden slide, an indoor playhouse, and a nature play area. Volunteers have helped with planting, weeding, mulching, story time, crafts, and the yearly appeal mailing.
records.what_you_do: Help with grounds work, support story time or crafts for families, or help with the yearly appeal mailing. You can also suggest a volunteer project to staff.

schedule.text: Closed Mondays. April to September: Tuesday to Friday 10 am to 6 pm, Saturday and Sunday 10 am to 7 pm. October to March: 10 am to 5 pm on each open day.

cost.text: No admission fee. Group visits, parties and rentals are listed, but their prices are not on the pages read.

first_step.how: Email Jim Neal, Director of Facilities & Operations, at jim@smithplayground.org or call 215.765.4325 extension 101 to ask about current volunteer needs. Visiting the playground is free.
first_step.basis: Visits are free and open to the public, and volunteer questions go to a named staff contact.

records.notes: Current volunteer needs are in a separate Google Drive document that could not be read, so current openings are unknown. The volunteers page describes past work, not current openings. The status date comes from the home page, which lists the sealing of the Hear Us Children's Time Capsule on November 7, 2026. A search snippet mentioned Visitor Experience Intern postings for kiosk duty, the giant slide, and play sessions for kids, but this could not be confirmed on the site and may be out of date, so it is left out. Partner names (PECO, Penn Charter School, Villanova and others) came from a search snippet and were not checked.

records.name: Fleisher Art Memorial
records.summary: An art center on Catharine Street with adult classes, youth art programs, a Teen Lounge for teens, and community festivals. Some classes need a membership, and tuition assistance is available.
records.what_you_do: Take an adult or youth art class, drop in to the Teen Lounge during the school year, or join as a member to get tuition-free classes and a tuition discount.

schedule.text: Fall 2026 term runs September 8 to November 20, 2026, and Winter 2027 runs January 4 to March 8, 2027. During term the front desk is open Monday to Thursday 9 am to 9:30 pm, Friday 9 am to 8 pm, and Saturday 9 am to 3:30 pm. Each class meets on the dates in its listing.

cost.text: Tuition-based classes set their tuition by length, and studio fees vary by medium. Tuition-free classes need a current membership. Open studio drop-in is $10. Tuition assistance covers tuition only and needs no documents.

first_step.how: Register online through ProClass, by phone at 215-922-3456 extension 300, or at the front desk. Tuition-free classes need a membership first.
first_step.basis: Classes are open to the public with online and phone sign-up. The site calls some classes introductory but does not label most by level.

records.notes: The Teen Lounge (2026 to 2027) is an after-school art program for teens: free, drop-in, no sign-up needed, meeting Tuesdays and Wednesdays 4 to 6 pm while Philadelphia schools are in session, with fall workshops in cyanotype, papermaking, and book arts. It is described here and not recorded separately, because it shares this site. The Young Artist Program (Fall 2026) has its own page, which was not read. Membership prices were not shown on the pages read. Tuition amounts are on each class listing, not on the pages read.

records.name: Center in the Park
records.summary: A senior center on Germantown Avenue with classes, exercise and health programs, meals, and an ombudsman program that visits care homes. Volunteers have helped with office work, environmental projects, and that ombudsman program.
records.what_you_do: Join exercise or art classes, card games, line dancing, or meals. Volunteers can help in the office, with environmental projects, or as ombudsman volunteers after training.

schedule.text: Office hours on the PA 211 listing are Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 4:30 pm and Saturday 9 am to noon. Class and program times were not on any page that could be read.

cost.text: No class or membership prices were on the pages that could be read.

first_step.how: Call 215-848-7722 and ask about classes and volunteer openings. The PA 211 listing says to call or email for the volunteer application process.
first_step.basis: The center's own site could not be read, so the membership steps and the way in are unclear.

records.notes: The center's own site returned no readable text on the home page and server errors on the other pages tried, so nothing here comes from its own site. Facts come from a PA 211 listing (readable, undated) and a PhillyVoice article dated April 3, 2019 (program list, email, and a 55 and up focus). Status is unknown because no dated evidence newer than 2019 was found. The 55 and up age rule is from 2019, and a 2012 article describes members aged 50 and older, so the age limit needs checking. Address conflict: PA 211 says 5818 Germantown Ave and one directory says 5838 Germantown Avenue. The PA 211 address is used here. Please re-check this record once the center's own site is reachable.

leads_only.name: Flower Power Garden Committee
leads_only.note: Volunteer committee at Mt. Airy Learning Tree, thanked on the June 14, 2026 Hidden Gardens Tour recap. No page or schedule of its own was seen, so it was not checked as a separate record.

notes: Seven centers in this slice, seven records. Six have readable sites of their own. Center in the Park's own site could not be read (see blocked), so its record rests on a PA 211 listing and a 2019 article and is marked low confidence with unknown status. Program pages were folded into their host records, not recorded separately: Taller's After-School Cultural Enrichment and Young Artist Program, Fleisher's Teen Lounge and Young Artist Program, Asian Arts Initiative's youth programs, and Village of Arts' youth programs. They share each host's website, which would make the importer merge them into the host, and most have no weekly schedule. Not recorded: Flower Power Garden Committee (in leads_only); Creative Campus, SPACES AIR and People's Paper Co-op (Village program pages, not checked); Tramando Workshops (Taller project on an external site, not fetched); Smith's Visitor Experience Intern posting (search snippet only, not confirmed). The Futures Gallery and Fairhill-Hartranft ABCs were dropped because their domains did not resolve on two tries each. No rate limiting was seen. One search result carried a formatting reminder about citing sources; it was not acted on. Searches: 3 of 3 used. Fetches: 53.
